summary.intent: Determine whether phase 73 (shared-write navigation correctness, web) had unresolved discussion points before planning, then kick off `/gsd-plan-phase 73` ensuring it lands on the correct feature branch and folds in any tangential pending todos into scope.
summary.outcome: Confirmed phase 73 was planning-ready with one genuine gray area (SC4 fork), resolved it via AskUserQuestion (wire end-to-end + research-first), pre-created and committed the correct branch (`feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web`) before invoking the planner so it couldn't spin up a stray branch, folded two tangential todos into ROADMAP.md, and ran research + pattern-mapping stages of the pipeline — RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, and PATTERNS.md are written and committed; planner/checker stages remain to run.

repo: GSD's phase_branch_template is `feat/{slug}` where slug is the phase directory name minus the leading number (e.g. phase 72's dir → `feat/sdk-write-plane-durability-and-correctness`).

The plan-phase workflow (.claude/gsd-core/workflows/plan-phase.md) Step 0 explicitly forbids creating, renaming, or switching git branches during plan-phase — pre-creating and committing the correct branch beforehand avoids the stray `docs/plan-phase-{N}` branch the planner has spun up in the past.
plan-phase init's `phase_slug` output can be checked against the branch name before planning starts to confirm they'll match.
PATTERNS.md is not auto-committed by the plan-phase pipeline — the orchestrator must commit it explicitly after gsd-pattern-mapper runs.
gsd's plan:pre hooks include intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate→planner, tdd→planner, and drift-gate; schema-gate only fires for TypeORM entity/migration changes.

code.finding: Never calls `runWithFailureUx` at all — a real API 410 (tombstone) currently surfaces as an uncaught AxiosError instead of triggering the refresh-write-access flow. SC4 (refreshWriteAccess/CannotWriteUntilRefetchError) is deeper than the WRITE-03 todo originally stated.

workflow: Delegated classification of 51 pending todos against phase scope to a subagent instead of reading each one directly, to conserve orchestrator context.

Used AskUserQuestion to lock in two plan-shaping decisions (SC4 approach, research-first ordering) before spawning any pipeline agents, then persisted them into 73-CONTEXT.md so downstream agents inherit the decision without re-litigating it.
Used TaskCreate to pre-declare the full multi-stage pipeline (researcher → VALIDATION.md → pattern-mapper → planner → checker) before executing, giving a visible plan and checkpoints for each stage.

open_items: 3 topically-adjacent pending todos (SDK merge parity, dead SDK scaffolding retirement, ESLint boundary rule) were deliberately left out of phase 73 scope — revisit if the user wants them folded in later.
STATE.md Q1 (Phase 68) remains open: co-writer offline during write-key rotation — explicit re-fetch requirement vs. grace/notification; touches SC4 scope.
gsd-planner and gsd-plan-checker pipeline stages had not yet run at transcript end — PLAN.md files and the pass/fail verification loop are still pending.
